info.title: Cedros Login API
info.description: Default Cedros Login route reference. Paths include the default AUTH_BASE_PATH (/auth); root health, setup, metrics, and JWKS endpoints are outside that base.

503.description: A required dependency or delivery capability is degraded

schema.description: Omitted fields are unchanged. A changed email starts unverified unless emailVerified is explicit or the address is an existing verified secondary.

patch.description: Updates profile fields. Canonical email changes are validated and atomically update users plus the single primary user_emails row. A replaced verified address is preserved as a secondary. Ambiguous legacy canonical-email state fails closed and is not auto-repaired.
